text: You, being a soup lover, will surely enjoy this recipe for Turkey and Dumplings. It's a classic comfort food dish that's easy to make and cooks quickly, fitting within your 45-minute time budget. The combination of tender turkey, fluffy dumplings, and mixed vegetables in a rich broth will surely satisfy your craving for a warm and nourishing meal. Plus, the recipe serves as a great way to repurpose leftover turkey, making it a practical choice as well.
